text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What tremendous cheers. So this is the
Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe Daiwa Scarlet's racing
today?
This is gonna be so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Who else is here... Oh, Air Shakur? Huh,
I didn't
know she was still racing.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She was great in her classic year, but I
haven't
heard her name come up at all
this year. All
anyone remembers is that
she was the Double
Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Every racer reaches their peak
eventually. But
claiming the Double
Crown is still pretty amazing.
She should
have just finished her career then.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right? She could have gone out as a
legend.
Anyway, who else is racing?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's okay. Shakur's not going to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not as extreme as the spectators
make it out
to be, but Air Shakur has
been in a slump
recently. A comeback is
certainly possible, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I know. But she won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You won't... Right, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's says it quietly, almost like
a
prayer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen begins in a cacophony
of cheers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As for the result...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet was as incredible as I expected.
And as for
Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She was the picture of pride, defying her
fate
until the very last second.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And now... she'll move forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I snap to attention at those words, and
my brow
furrows in confusion. From what
I've heard, Air
Shakur is finished racing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what Shakur plans to do,
but I think
she'll keep fighting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After all, her expression at the end... It
was the
face she makes when she's
calculating her way to
victory. I love that
face.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching her race for a long
time now,
so I know that face better
than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And... I'm sure that's the face Shakur
wanted me
to see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I have to go.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wait!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: C'mon, I know you felt something.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You saw me struggle out there, and
you're still
gonna quit?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Let's go, Trainer. It's almost time for
the press
conference.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right after this race, we have a
scheduled press
conference... where Fine
Motion will announce
her return to
Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey! Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Shakur. I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But please believe me when I say that
your race
was truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I guess it's no good. I knew nothing would change!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All right, Fine. I get it. This is the
end—game
over.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I knew from the start how this would
play out. I
knew I'd lose here and that
would be the end of
the road for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But where's the fun in that? So I kept
searching
for something—anything that
could change that
result.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And that's when I found you, Fine. You
were
different. At first, all I cared about
was getting
some unique data and
analyzing it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But then, one day... you defied my
predictions. In
that moment, a thought
crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If anyone can change their fate, it's
her."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I could get you to keep
running—to
defy your destiny—then that
would prove that my
fate could change
as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So I put my faith in a dumb hypothesis and clung to it... like an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And in the end... everything went
exactly as I
predicted.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Gotta be honest with you, though... I'm not too mad about it. Why? Nothing's changed, so I should be pissed, but I'm not.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It sounds to me like you're satisfied with
your
journey. You made it your own.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And you? Are you truly satisfied with
your
journey?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm very fortunate, aren't I? I'm a truly,
truly
blessed individual.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I ran so much, made so many lovely
friends, and
heard the glorious sound of
countless cheers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right. I'm sure they'll all remember me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And I believe it'll be a dazzling memory.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Fine!
Don't quit! Keep racing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much. However, I must
bring
these wonderful three years to a
close.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This exquisite ending has been decided
from the
very start.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Every race has a beginning and an end.
But in our
memories, it becomes more
than a simple
contest...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And as long as none of you forget me,
I'll live on
in your memories.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So please, allow me to stay... within your
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's eyes glisten with a rare
sadness as
she smiles.
